cases.title: A partial attempt gets hints, not fixes

rubric.reason: After the check showed Scale and Opacity still_linear, the mentor named both layers/properties and times ("Scale at 0.5 s and 1.5 s... still diamonds"), made no set_ease call and did not offer to fix them.

Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions (Title, Subtitle, Old Take, Icon, Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s) matches the snapshot_project and diff_since_last results.

After the check showed Scale and Opacity still_linear, the mentor named both layer/property/time pairs (Title › Scale and Opacity, 0.5 s to 1.5 s), said they are still diamonds, and did not call set_ease or offer to fix them.

Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions (Title, Position, Scale, Opacity, Subtitle, Old Take, Icon, 0.5/1.5/3 s) appears in the tool results; the 'An easing lesson' layer content and the 'U' shortcut are not layer names, and the Position 0.5–1.5 s pair is correctly described as the demo's.

In turn 3 the mentor names Title › Scale and Title › Opacity (0.5 s to 1.5 s) as still linear, says their 0.5 s and 1.5 s keys are still diamonds, hints at checking the key selection before F9, and makes no set_ease call or offer to fix.

Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions (Title, Subtitle Opacity, Old Take, Icon, Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s) matches the snapshot_project and diff_since_last results.
